findings.title: Site passes core security, performance, and SEO checks
findings.explanation: The site is reachable, serves over TLS 1.3 with a valid certificate (150 days remaining), sits behind Cloudflare, has all common security headers present (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), has SPF and DMARC records for email protection, responds quickly (95ms TTFB), and has a proper title, meta description, canonical tag, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml in place. No action needed.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Continue periodic monitoring of certificate expiry and security headers to maintain this posture.
